question: Deepthi Jeevanji set a new world record in the women’s T20 400-m event at the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**World Para Athletics Championships**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Deepthi Jeevanji set a new world record in the women's T20 400-m event at the **World Para Athletics Championships**.
 
• The World Para Athletics Championships is a prominent event organized by the **International Paralympic Committee (IPC)**.
 
• The Championships are held biennially, bringing together the best para-athletes from around the world.
 
• The T20 classification is for athletes with an intellectual impairment, ensuring fair competition among similarly challenged competitors.
 
• The 2023 edition of the World Para Athletics Championships took place in Paris, France.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Paralympic Committee (IPC)**

 
 
• The IPC is the global governing body of the Paralympic Movement.
 
• It organizes the Paralympic Games and oversees the organization of World Para Athletics Championships.
 
• Founded on September 22, 1989, the IPC aims to enable para-athletes to achieve sporting excellence and inspire and excite the world.
 
 
 
• **Classification in Para Athletics**
 
 
• Classification ensures a level playing field by grouping athletes with similar impairments together.
 
• Classes include physical, visual, and intellectual impairments, with specific codes for each category.
 
• The T20 classification specifically caters to athletes with intellectual impairments.
 
 
 
• **World Para Athletics Championships**
 
 
• The Championships are a major event in the para-athletics calendar, held every two years.
 
• They feature a wide range of track and field events for athletes with various types of impairments.
 
• The event serves as a qualifying competition for the Paralympic Games.
 
 
 
• **Records and Achievements**
 
 
• Setting a world record is a significant achievement, highlighting the athlete's exceptional performance.
 
• World records are officially recognized by the IPC and require stringent verification processes.
